scope: Read-only inspection of historical f01-d7-width4-proof2 source, same-run D9 baseline, seed-809 official public-v2 plan, raw verdicts and D7 current-source differences. New supplement only; prior F4 opportunity review remains unchanged. No candidate/Git/CI/test actions.

run_identity_correction.correction: Run 39839349846 must not be cited as the seed-809 full-gate/timing result. The full gate and score are from 39847080316. Some prior candidate-catalog/source-freeze references point at the earlier statement-only artifact.

comparison_record.interpretation: All ratios greater than 1 are slower than D9. This is a global width4/width8 comparison, not a p3/p4-only comparison.

six_bmm_cell_normalized_width4_over_D9.bucket_note: These are six plan-cell aggregates. Each cell can contain several shape cases and does not isolate p.

per_p_runtime_attribution.reason: The raw gate verdict retains per-round totals and six BMM cell aggregates; it contains no per-case latency. The drawn plan binds shapes/work but not measured durations. The six BMM cells mix p values.

what_the_old_width4_source_did.packB_layout: [batch][column-block][k], four Float32 fields per packet, invalid columns zero padded.
what_the_old_width4_source_did.output_lane_mapping: j/4 selects a four-column block and j%4 selects the lane.
what_the_old_width4_source_did.dispatch: No p<=4 or n>4 specialization guard. The nonempty-output/nonzero-reduction BMM routes through Packed4 for all sampled output widths.
what_the_old_width4_source_did.sampled_widths: The seed-809 plan contains p values 1 through 59 (not every integer); all these cases used the same width-four implementation.

fallback.slow_case: Fin.foldl n from +0 over the entire original Binary32 multiply/add sequence.
fallback.semantics: Infinity as well as NaN takes the full replay. No current NaN-only quiet-stop path.

what_the_old_width4_source_did.writer: The old RowStream uses Vector.ofFn/flatMap and RowOutput.row uses Vector.ofFn for lanes; it is not the current D11 Array-backed output writer.

classification.mechanism: F4 four-column packets, four ordered accumulators, lane projection and column-block address mapping
classification.relation_to_old_width4: Same core microkernel/source family; not a novel mechanism.

classification.mechanism: Only p=3/4 and n>4 branch; leave other p widths on current parent paths
classification.relation_to_old_width4: Substantively new dispatch domain. Old width4 routes every sampled p through four-wide blocks.

classification.mechanism: Current nonNaN guard plus R7NaNReplay.replayEarly quiet-stop cold fallback
classification.relation_to_old_width4: Substantively different fallback. Current D11 fast path admits infinities; only NaN results use exact raw replay from k=0, which may stop once the accumulator is quiet-absorbing. Old width4 sent every nonfinite result, including infinities, through a full n-step replay.
Substantively different surrounding output pipeline. Old width4 materializes row vectors with Vector.ofFn/flatMap.

current_path_and_proposal_differences.current_scope_context: Current D11 has a separate p=2 CrossRows path. p=3/4,n>4 currently reaches Packed10 after the other guards; p=3/4,n<=4 takes DirectContinuous. The proposed F4 branch targets only the former.
current_path_and_proposal_differences.performance_status_for_narrow_proposal: UNKNOWN; no p=3/4-only full-call run exists.

interpretation.strong_negative_result: Do not copy or globally dispatch the old width4 implementation: the same-seed full suite comparison is slower overall and BMM is 45.7% slower normalized versus D9.
interpretation.does_not_disprove: The p=3/4,n>4 guarded branch with current NaN/cold replay and continuous writer, because the historical verdict has no p-specific timing and used a global width4 route plus full nonfinite replay.
interpretation.does_not_prove: Any speedup for p=3/4. The p-bucket runtime remains UNKNOWN; R12's proposed surrounding changes still need an exact-source same-run measurement.
